independence: Root adapted helpers; reviewer authored ferricopiapite/rhomboclase and independently reviewed bassanite. This is separate static operational assessment.
scope: Complete source reading of five external Python helpers plus config; AST parse only, actual producer/schema and preservation context inspected. No top-level helper execution, network observation, Git/GitHub mutation or runtime-success claim.

findings.description: The commit helper accepts generic success flags/log hashes from four earlier receipts, then stages current files without checking the final-gates record_inputs, current review/coverage inputs, base/worktree identity or config census. An owner edit after a passing gate still satisfies these guards and can be committed under stale validation. Missing success keys also default to success. This is a helper contract defect, not evidence that the currently frozen scientific files changed.
findings.evidence: Read entire source; the only receipt checks are d.get(exit_code,0)==0, d.get(passed,True) and optional log digest at lines6–8. No record_inputs or coverage current-input comparison exists before git add/commit.
acceptance: Require the actual expected per-receipt schema/success fields and trusted base/worktree/count identities before staging.
Recompute exact final-gate owner input digests and bind the actual review/coverage input census/selected current reviews to current bytes.
Preserve initial helper snapshot and independently assess a narrow successor; no new scientific finding or unnecessary suite rerun.

findings.description: The existing commit-receipt path is rejected only after git add and git commit. An already-existing receipt with a base checkout can cause a successful mutation followed by an assertion, leaving the new commit without its own accepted receipt.
findings.evidence: Output-path assertion appears on line20 after mutation lines15/17. Other reviewed mutators reject their output path up front.
acceptance: Reject an existing or symlink output receipt before any staging/commit mutation.
Retain exclusive creation at final write so a late collision cannot silently overwrite evidence.

positive_checks: Cleanup checks exact current topic branch/head and clean WT, live remote ref expected old SHA, exact actual merge tree/sole parent; detach/delete scope is owned branch only.

Sync checks actual postmerge identity/log/required validation outcomes, original 7,493 nontracked file hashes/modes/symlink targets, immutable tag and backup manifest, exact remote main/sole parent/tree, incoming-versus-hidden/ignored path collisions and ff-only/no-autostash before and after.

Enqueue checks exact preflight base/head/tree/counts/log, required validation commands, local clean exact head, current PR title/body/pathset/required checks/COMMENT and native squash queue rules; records immediately prior live main.

Hosted-five reads current PR/head/tree/sole parent, complete paginated files/blobs, exact five current workflow roles/attempt-specific jobs and closing identities. Pending runs remain pending, explicit issue states are caller supplied, unique receipts preserve observations.
No round95 cohort/count text found in the six bounded files using hidden/ignored-inclusive literal search. Historical retained tag is intentionally unchanged.
Config six slugs/current base/branch and forecast465/533/550/97/465 agree with assigned cohort; final review/coverage receipt completion remains a runtime prerequisite.
limitations: Full package scientific currentness and all pending runtime actions are not established by this static review.
Hosted-five presently declares root as executor/coordinator. A different executing reviewer must use truthful explicit attribution before runtime.
